keys: Adds an old television screen look.
en: Adds an old television screen look.
zh: 启用老式电视屏幕画面效果。

keys: Connects to a dedicated server running on this machine (127.0.0.1) instead of the public server.
en: Connects to a dedicated server running on this machine (127.0.0.1) instead of the public server.
zh: 连接到本机专用服务器（127.0.0.1）而非公共服务器。

keys: Makes the game fill your whole screen.
en: Makes the game fill your whole screen.

keys: Resets all game windows to their default size and position.
en: Resets all game windows to their default size and position.
zh: 将所有游戏窗口恢复为默认大小与位置。

keys: Sends anonymous crash and error reports to help fix bugs. No personal data is collected.
en: Sends anonymous crash and error reports to help fix bugs. No personal data is collected.
zh: 发送匿名崩溃与错误报告以帮助修复问题，不会收集任何个人数据。

keys: Sets the size of the game window.
en: Sets the size of the game window.

keys: Sets the volume of alerts meant for you: whispers, level ups, skill ups and quest updates.
en: Sets the volume of alerts meant for you: whispers, level ups, skill ups and quest updates.
zh: 设置专属提示音量：私聊、升级、技能提升与任务更新。

keys: Sets the volume of combat feedback like hits, crits, dodges and heals.
en: Sets the volume of combat feedback like hits, crits, dodges and heals.
zh: 设置战斗反馈音量：命中、暴击、闪避与治疗。

keys: Sets the volume of creatures and surrounding objects: attacks, deaths and chests opening.
en: Sets the volume of creatures and surrounding objects: attacks, deaths and chests opening.
zh: 设置生物与环境音量：攻击、死亡与开箱。

keys: Sets the volume of every sound in the game at once.
en: Sets the volume of every sound in the game at once.
zh: 一次性设置游戏中所有声音的音量。

keys: Sets the volume of fights you are not part of. Your own actions and your target stay at full volume.
en: Sets the volume of fights you are not part of. Your own actions and your target stay at full volume.
zh: 设置非本人战斗的音量。你自己的动作与目标始终保持全音量。

keys: Sets the volume of the background music.
en: Sets the volume of the background music.

keys: Shows touch buttons on screen for movement and actions.
en: Shows touch buttons on screen for movement and actions.
zh: 在屏幕上显示移动与操作的触屏按钮。

keys: Silences the game while its window is in the background.
en: Silences the game while its window is in the background.
zh: 游戏窗口在后台时静音。

keys: Smooths the image when the view is scaled up.
en: Smooths the image when the view is scaled up.

keys: Turns on dynamic lights and shadows.
en: Turns on dynamic lights and shadows.

keys: Type the new password you want to use from now on.
en: Type the new password you want to use from now on.
zh: 输入你以后要使用的新密码。

keys: Type your current password so we know it is really you.
en: Type your current password so we know it is really you.
zh: 输入当前密码以便确认是你本人。

keys: Type your new password again so it can be checked for typos.
en: Type your new password again so it can be checked for typos.
zh: 再次输入新密码以检查输入错误。

keys: Zooms the whole game view by one, two or three times.
en: Zooms the whole game view by one, two or three times.
zh: 将整个游戏视图放大一、二或三倍。
